# dsh-zgit

> dsh-zgit (zgit) is a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that fetches source archives and binary releases from git hosts (GitHub, GitLab, Gitee) over plain HTTPS — no git binary, no clone, zero runtime dependencies.

dsh-zgit reimplements the read side of git over forge APIs, so a DSH agent can obtain source code and release artifacts without a git binary on the machine.

Key facts:
- npm package: `dsh-zgit` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-zgit), latest 0.2.2
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zgit` — or from Git: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:zukunftsholz/dsh-zgit`
- Targets DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2 (cordis 4.0.2, schemastery 3.18.2).
- Zero runtime dependencies (Node builtins only). No git binary required.
- Tools: zgit_ls_remote, zgit_clone, zgit_fetch_release, zgit_show, zgit_ls_tree, zgit_log, zgit_diff, zgit_status, zgit_download — plus a human-plane `/zgit` slash command.
- Hosts: GitHub, GitLab (API v4, nested groups), Gitee (API v5); generic GitHub-style self-hosted hosts for archive/raw URL guessing.
- Source fetching produces a simulated checkout: a normal directory with `.zerogit/meta.json` and `.zerogit/HEAD`.
- Verification: sha256 for release assets and zgit_download; CRC32 for zip entries; gzip bomb guard; workspace-confined writes.
- License: MIT.
